card.name: Linking words inside lists and pairs
card.fires_on: Small linking words and commas (but, and, of, either, a comma) that come right after a noun and lead into a second item or clause. They appear in general web prose and in label text.

modes.label: Conjunction after a clause
modes.description: 'but' or 'and' joining a second item or clause after a subject.
modes.example: Alan Turing's Enigma machine not only helped the allies win World War II,<< but>> catalyzed development of the first generation

modes.label: Comma in a list
modes.description: A comma after the first or second item in a list of nouns.
modes.example: Please include your full name<<,>> address and phone number (the city

modes.label: 'of' after worsening
modes.description: The word 'of' after 'worsening', before a condition.
modes.example: can lead to onset of new hypertension or worsening<< of>> preexisting hypertension, either of which may

card.plain: It fires on small joining words and commas that sit between two items in a pair or list.
